name: Trophy
purpose: Placeable block from this mod; it may be decorative, functional, or a recipe ingredient depending on JEI/EMI uses.
acquire: Acquire through crafting, stonecutting, loot, worldgen, or creative depending on the block; JEI/EMI is the final recipe source.
use: Place it in-world; press U in JEI/EMI to see recipes, multiblock roles, or crafting uses.
